results.title: Foreigners in Nigeria’s retail market: What the law says
results.snippet:
Share

ON September 15, 2026, traders at the Lagos Trade Fair Complex staged a protest, alleging that Chinese merchants were selling goods at retail prices, a development they said threatens local businesses’ survival. This report by The ICIR examines the legal and regulatory framework governing foreign participation in Nigeria’s retail market. It analyses what the law says about fair competition
